verdict.rationale: Ledgy lets admins create dedicated API service accounts under Company Settings. These authenticate via OAuth 2.0 client_credentials, are described as 'scoped per integration', issue short-lived tokens (24h), and can be revoked immediately or have their secret rotated, so a separate, isolatable credential can be issued for an agent. However, nothing documents restricting a service account's permissions (e.g., read-only access, specific operations or companies), so true least-privilege is not shown. Missing for 10: selectable permission scopes or roles per service account, read-only or per-operation restriction, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
